title: Nvidia Stock (NVDA) Falls 2.0% as CEO Uncertainty Lingers (Nov 13)
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) fell 2.01% to $162.85 on Nov 13 as uncertainty after Jensen Huang's exit as CEO and a chip selloff weighed on the stock.
body_markdown:
## Why Nvidia Stock Fell


Financial media tied Friday's drop to lingering uncertainty over Nvidia's leadership after Huang's exit, alongside a selloff in semiconductor stocks. According to[Nvidia's November 12 release](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition/) , Huang resigned as President, CEO and board member effective immediately, and CFO Colette Kress agreed to serve as interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor among internal and external candidates. The release gave no reason, while CNBC reported that the resignation followed public reports about his personal conduct. The shares had already[fallen on Thursday after the announcement](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-13-2026/) .


On Friday, Nvidia rose 2% after the open, according to[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-friday-november-13-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-nvidia-ppi-141451558.html) , before slipping as a selloff in the semiconductor sector accelerated. As reported by[Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/coverage/stock-market-today/2026/11/13/stock-market-today-nov-13-nvidia-slides-after-hsbc-downgrades-stock-to-hold-on-ceo-uncertainty/) , HSBC analyst Frank Lee also revised his view on the stock that day, citing the absence of a permanent CEO and the risk that revenue from outside the US and Taiwan, about 11% of the total over the last six quarters, could face stricter export rules.


Per[AFP](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/musk-uber-co-founder-join-231643816.html) , shareholders Brad Gerstner and Gavin Baker urged the board on Friday to keep "all options" open. Over the weekend, more than 158,000 people, including Elon Musk and Uber co-founder Travis Kalanick, signed an open letter calling for Huang's return, and AFP cited a Financial Times report that Huang has discussed a possible return with people close to him. Those developments came after Friday's close.


## NVDA Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Nvidia said its board expects the company's operations, customer commitments and product roadmap to continue without interruption, according to the company's release.
- Analysts project quarterly revenue growth of 91% from a year earlier to $108.9 billion, according to LSEG data cited by CNBC.


### Risks


- Nvidia has no permanent CEO yet, and HSBC's Lee pointed to the leadership gap, per Motley Fool.
- HSBC flagged possible stricter export rules, and AFP reported that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent asked Nvidia on Sunday to explain whether it knowingly ignored the smuggling of its chips to China.
- CNBC said the stock had slid with the AI trade on concerns that rising interest rates would punish debt-heavy companies, including neocloud customers that rely on debt markets, as the 10-year yield closed Friday at 5.15%.


Nvidia's next[earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) , for the third quarter of fiscal 2027, is due Tuesday, November 17, after the market close, according to the company, and Motley Fool noted it will be the first without Huang.
